method: ENGINEERING native-touch camera metrology. Original level, AI removed/suppressed and rifle assistance off to isolate look input; exact camera/options resets are arranged. Tap-intent feedback, real native event batches and angular displacement measured. Not natural aim quality, ergonomics, timing, performance or enjoyment.

checks.name: threshold sweep measures small scene start while30px and larger retain normal displacement
event segmentation, diagonal intent and reversing a drag preserve deterministic camera motion
tap opt-out keeps immediate linear small movement and AIM keeps its finer gain
optional faster turns retain their large-swipe distance and batch independence
